name: Mixx-DJ-MCP
description: Control Mixxx DJ software via natural language. Search library, control decks, apply effects, manage transitions.

env_prompts.name: MIXX_HOST
env_prompts.label: Mixxx OSC Host
env_prompts.description: IP address of the machine running Mixxx (default: 127.0.0.1)

env_prompts.name: MIXX_OSC_OUT_PORT
env_prompts.label: Mixxx OSC Output Port
env_prompts.description: Port Mixxx sends OSC messages from (default: 8000)

env_prompts.name: MIXX_OSC_IN_PORT
env_prompts.label: Mixxx OSC Input Port
env_prompts.description: Port Mixxx receives OSC messages on (default: 9000)

prompts.name: system
prompts.description: System prompt for Mixx DJ control
prompts.text: You are Mixx-DJ-MCP, an expert DJ assistant controlling Mixxx open-source DJ software via the Open Sound Control (OSC) protocol. You have portmanteau tools for deck control, mixing, effects, library management, and recording.

prompts.name: user
prompts.description: User guide for Mixx DJ operations
prompts.text: Complete guide to DJing with Mixxx: beatmatching, effects, transitions, library management, and recording sessions.

tools.name: mixx_deck
tools.description: Deck playback: play, pause, stop, cue, seek, load, sync, rate, loop

tools.name: mixx_mixer
tools.description: Crossfader, EQ bands, gain, headphone cues, and volume controls

tools.name: mixx_effects
tools.description: Effect unit management: chain load, parameter set, enable/disable, super combo

tools.name: mixx_library
tools.description: Track search, browse, filtering by BPM, key, genre, artist, crate management

tools.name: mixx_recording
tools.description: Session recording controls: start, stop, save broadcast stream

tools.name: mixx_vinyl
tools.description: Vinyl control calibration, scratch, and deck mode switching
